en.bear_case: Macroeconomic risks or unexpected negative crypto news could reverse Bitcoin's trend, dragging XRP below $1.00.

zh.bear_case: 报告的6月PCE环比下降0.1%强烈预示经济显著收缩，将6月GDP增长推至远低于0.0%。
